SELECT p.post_id::TEXT AS row_id, p.title, p.content, (SELECT u.nickname FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = p.reg_id) AS reg_name, TO_CHAR(p.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_dt FROM post p WHERE p.board_id = #{boardId}::integer AND ORDER BY p.post_id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT m.conn_cd, m.conn_id::TEXT AS conn_id, m.link_url FROM menu m WHERE m.area = 'GEN' AND m.use_yn = 'Y' AND m.conn_cd IN ('MENU01', 'MENU02', 'MENU03', 'MENU05') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth a WHERE a.menu_id = m.menu_id AND a.type = 'GRP' AND a.menu_yn = 'Y' AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.conn_id = 'GUEST') AND (m.conn_cd <> 'MENU02' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board b WHERE b.board_id = m.conn_id AND b.use_yn = 'Y')) AND (m.conn_cd <> 'MENU03' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM page g WHERE g.page_id = m.conn_id AND g.use_yn = 'Y')) AND (m.conn_cd <> 'MENU05' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM form f WHERE f.form_id = m.conn_id AND f.use_yn = 'Y')) ORDER BY m.p_menu_id, m.sort_no, m.menu_id
